tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgra rgyan gyi bstan bcos mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog blo gsal mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// shrī rā dī bud+dha ya na maḥ dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mi'i ston mchog ston mchog gang gi bstan pa 'phags yul rgyas mdzad mdzad po paṇa grub tshogs/ /bod yul gangs ljongs gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya'i bla chen chen po yab sras dang / /gnas lnga kun mkhyen kun mkhyen mchog gyur sa skya paṇa chen khu dbon dbon dang sras su bcas/ /sa skya lo tsā lo tsā bai ro'i rnam 'phrul sngags 'chang yab sras sras mchog mched gnyis rgyal/ /gang gi bsod nams 'khri shing gsar pa gsar pa'i me tog snying rje chen po g.yo ba'i gar/ /ngo bo nyid kyi rang bzhin bzang po bzang po'i gnas tshul nam yang stong pa min pa nyid/ /legs byas 'bras bu don gnyer de nyid de nyid don la brtse bas yang yang sbyor mdzad pa'i/ /mtshungs med bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rgyal mtshan bzhin du kun gyi gtsug der mtho gyur cig /btso ma'i gser sbyangs rin chen phra bkod lam lam 'phyong zur ba gam bkod pa'i khri steng rtser/ /sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la sgeg sgeg 'gyings pa'i bcom ldan thub pa rab mdzes sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje skyil krung mer mer bdud rtsis khengs pa'i lhung bzed phyag na bsnams/ /gser 'od 'khyug pa'i dpal rab dang ldan mdzes mdzes lha mchog kho bo'i gtsug tu zhabs brtan mdzod/ /hrīḥyig las 'khrungs tsher tsher 'od 'phro lhag lhag rgyan ldan tshe dpag med mgon mchog /mchog tu tshe bum mer mer tshe chus lhud lhud khengs pa'i zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rgyun du spyi bor chil chil phab nas sim sim thim mdzad 'chi med dngos grub ster ba'i lha/ /lha mchog khyed kyis yang yang nyid du phyur phyur khengs pa'i tshe dbang de ring bdag la skur/

/rab dkar 'o ma'i chu mtsho las 'ong lbu ba dkar po'i me tog chil chil g.yo ba'i 'gram/ /thal dkar glang chen mche ba drug ldan dngul dkar bya ma'i thang la rab rgyu'i chu gter dbus/ /pad dkar bzhad ldan sdong po'i steng na rab mdzes dkar gsal zla bar 'gying ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ /shes dkar la sogs rgyan gyis rab mdzes 'od dkar 'khrug ldan 'jam dbyangs lha des bdag cag skyongs/ /rin chen margad ri bo ltar mdzes mdzes ldan lha mo sgrol ma mchog /mchog tu mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis rab bkra bkra ba'i 'od zer du mas mdzes/ /mdzes ldan ma khyod snying la dgod do do shal nor bu'i phreng ba mchog /mchog tu mdzes pas nu 'bur rab rgyan rgyan ldan ma khyod gtsug gis bsten/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen pa'i chos la rab mkhas mkhas par rab grags grags pa don ldan mang du yod mod de ltar na'ang / /rig gnas gnas tshul chos rnams rab rtogs rtogs pa su yod yod na rang lus bstan de nga dang smra bar gyis/ /des na na tshod rgan pa'i tshul bzung bzung pas mi phan phan pa gang de gnas lnga'i chos tshul 'di yin zhes/ /lan mang mang du yang dang yang du du mar bsgrags zin zin par gnas lnga'i chos tshul zab mo 'di la sbyongs/ /tshul 'di 'di dang gzhan du bde ba'i gnas/ /gnas tshul tshul bzhin rtogs nas smras pa yin/ /yin lugs lugs bzhin go na sman gyi mchog /mchog de de ring ngas bshad longs shig bu/ /legs sbyar skad la gsungs pa'i sgra rgyan ni/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpe brjod gsal ba ru/ /tshang la ma nor bod la sngon chad dkon/ /de phyir kho bos dper brjod rdzogs par bya/ /yi ge tshogs pa gnyis phan chad/ /bskor ba'am bzlas pa zung ldan no/ /de yang yi ge gzhan gyis ni/ /bar ma chod dang bar chod gnyis/ /de yang rkang pa re re ba'i/ /dang po bar dang mtha' ma'i gnas/ /rkang gcig gnyis gsum bzhi la'o/ /gcig la'ang yod pa dang po dang /

/gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa la'o/ /de yang thog ma bar dang mtha'/ /de bzhin bar mtha' bar dang thog /thog mtha' dang ni kun la'o/ /gzhan yang kun tu zung ldan sogs/ /de dag dbye ba shin tu mang / /'on kyang bya bla bya dka' ru/ /bsdus te 'ga' zhig bstan par bya/ /de yang bar ma chod pa yi/ /dper brjod 'ga' zhig 'dir mtshon te/ /de yang dang po'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa dper/ /mer mer margad zhu ba 'khyil 'dra'i rlabs phreng g.yo ba zla ris bkra ba chu mtsho'i 'gram/ /pad rtsa rkang 'khyog lo ma'i gur lding 'dab ma stong ldan pad dkar g.yo ba'i ge sar rtser/ /zla dkar gdan la dbyangs can bu mo sgeg pa'i nyams ldan tsog pu'i tshul gyis 'gying ma khyod/ /'brug mgo'i gzengs mtho rgyud mang la bsnun ut+pal spyan zur g.yon du g.yo ba'i gar gyis rol/ /rkang pa gnyis pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa dper/ /me tog dkar po'i phreng bas thod mdzes shing / /khrol khrol gser gyi rna cha 'gram par 'phyang / /mkhur tshos dmar po'i me tog 'dzum gyis bsdu/ /dbyangs can bu mo khyod kyis bdag yid skyongs/ /rkang pa gsum pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa dper/ /mthon mthing dbu skra'i zar bu g.yon du g.yo/ /tshems dkar bzhi bcu'i 'od ris g.yo ba can/ /sil sil phyag zhabs gdu bu'i sgra khrol ba'i/ /dri za'i bu mos bdag yid ring du skyongs/ /rkang pa bzhi pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa dper/ /spyan zur mdzes pa'i 'dzum gyi gzhan yid 'phrog /nu 'bur rgyas pa'i nu ma ngom byed cing / /lag sor brel ba'i 'du byed bsgyur byas nas/ /sing sing rgyud mang sgra yis rol der 'dud /des ni gcig gi thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa bstan/ /dang po gnyis kyi thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa dper/ /legs legs thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa yis/ /mdzes mdzes dga' ma'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu/

/dri za'i rgyud mang bsnun la mngon dga' ma/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo khyod kyis bdag yid skyongs/ /dang po gsum pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa dper/ /lhag lhag 'od zer 'bar ba'i rgyan gyi tshogs/ /sku yi cha shas ma lus mdzes par spras/ /tsher tsher zla ba'i gtsug rgyan 'od 'phro ma/ /thor cog sngon po'i mdzes par byas la 'dud/ /dang po bzhi pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa dper/ /ling ling gser gyi cod pan sgyur byed cing / /la ba dkar po'i na bza' rlung gis g.yob/ /sgeg cing 'gyings pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma/ /khyil khyil 'khyil ba'i zla dkar gdan la bzhugs/ /gnyis pa gsum pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa dper/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba'i g.yang sa nyam nga'i gnas/ /thib thib 'thib pa mun pa'i gcong rong du/ /yang yang lhung bar gyur pa 'di gzigs la/ /dbyangs can khyed kyis brtse bas bdag skyongs shig /gnyis pa bzhi pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa dper/ /bdag ni sngon gyi las ngan drag po'i mthus/ /'ur 'ur sgra sgrog dmyal ba'i me nang du/ /lhung nas nyam thag nga ro 'byin gyur na/ /yang yang dbyangs can khyed kyi thugs rjes skyobs/ /gsum pa bzhi pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa dper/ /bdag ni ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur te/ /dngos 'dzin bag chags ring du goms pa'i mthus/ /las las byung ba'i sdig sgrib tshan po ches/ /yang yang 'khor bar lhung pa bzlog tu gsol/ /des ni gnyis kyi thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa bstan/ /dang po gsum gyi thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa dper/ /'jigs 'jigs gshin rje'i skyes bus zin pa'i tshe/ /lhang lhang tshig gis dbyangs can khyed bos nas/ /dung dung gdung bas gsol ba btab gyur na/ /glo bur 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'di las skyobs/ /dang po gnyis pa bzhi pa'i thog /zung ldan bar ma chod pa dper/ /'dzum 'dzum zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rab bzhad cing /

/khyug khyug spyan zur phra mo'i zur gyis 'tsho/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i snying mun sel mdzad ma/ /hṛṃ hṛṃ sngags kyi sgra ldan ma des skyongs/ /dang po gsum pa bzhi pa'i thog /zung ldan bar ma chod pa'i dper/ /gzhon nu gzhon nu ma la dga' ba ltar/ /dbyangs can mdzes ma khyod la bdag yid dad/ /sbrang rtsi sbrang rtsi spyod pas myangs pa bzhin/ /skye ba skye bar khyod gsung bdud rtsi bsten/ /gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa'i thog /zung ldan bar ma chod pa dper/ /bdag ni thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /dngos po dngos po med pa'i chos rnams kyis/ /rang bzhin rang bzhin med par ma mthong pas/ /skye ba skye bar 'ching ba 'di las skyobs/ /des ni gsum gyi thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa bstan/ /rkang pa bzhi ka'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa dper/ /rig rig spyan zur phra mo'i zur mig mda'/ /long long skye bo'i tshogs la rab 'phangs pas/ /las las byung ba'i sdig sgrib thams cad ni/ /sangs sangs dag nas thar pa'i zhing la 'god/ /de rnams kyis ni thog ma ru/ /zung ldan bar ma chod pa yi/ /dbye ba bco lnga bstan zin to/ /da ni bar du chod pa yi/ /zung ldan 'ga' yang bstan par bya/ /dang po gnyis pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan gzugs shig bar chod dper/ /kun bzang thugs rje bsam 'phel nor bu'i gter/ /kun bzang gsung gi rlabs phreng me tog g.yo/ /yid 'phrog lha mo 'o ma'i rgya mtsho che/ /bdag yid chu bya'i dga' ba spel du gsol/ /dang po gsum pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dper/ /rab mdzes pad dkar zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /tsog pu'i tshul bzhugs rgyud mang sgra yis rol/ /rab mdzes ke la sha yi mdangs 'dzin pa'i/ /dbyangs can bu mo sgeg mo'i zhabs der 'dud/ /dang po bzhi pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dper/ /dbyangs can khyed nyid thugs rje'i gzhan dbang du/

/gyur kyang khyod zhal dri med pad+mo'i rdul/ /lhar bcas gtsug gi cod pan ltar byas pa'i/ /dbyangs can khyod las gzhan pa'i skyabs ma mchis/ /gnyis pa gsum pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dper/ /da dung lan mang 'khor ba'i gcong rong du/ /srid pa'i khol bo rnams dang bdag lhan cig /srid par skye ba blangs nas sdug bsngal na/ /dbyangs can khyod kyis 'khor bar bdag gtong ngam/ /gnyis pa bzhi pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dper/ /gal te dbyangs can khyed nyid btang snyoms bzhugs/ /khyed kyi thugs rjes su la ci zhig bgyid/ /mi zad las kyi bran gyur bdag lta bu/ /khyed kyi thugs rjes yal bar 'dor ram ci/ /gsum pa bzhi pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dper/ /las kyi nus pas 'gro ba gar lhung yang / /khyed kyi thugs rje'i yal bar mi 'dor bar/ /'khor ba mi zad 'brog dgon spangs gyur te/ /'khor ba'i chu chen 'di las khyed kyis sgrol/ /des ni gnyis kyi thog ma yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod bstan/ /dang po gsum gyi thog ma yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dper/ /rab dkar pad+ma gzhon nu g.yo ba'i rtser/ /rab dkar ri bong 'dzin pa'i gdan steng du/ /rab dkar ke la sha yi mdangs 'dzin pa'i/ /dbyangs can bu mo'i zhabs der bdag yid dad/ /dang po gsum pa bzhi pa yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dper/ /rab gsal dri med shel gyi gzhal yas khang / /mu tig mdzes pa'i yal 'dab bkod pa ltar/ /rab gsal dri med khyed sku thor cog rtser/ /rab gsal zla ba dkar pos mdzes par byas/ /'og ma gsum gyi thog ma yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dper/ /gang zhig mtho ris bu mo'i lag pa yis/ /rab mdzes lha yi rnga yab g.yob pa dang / /rab mdzes mu tig gdugs dkar 'dzin pa gnyis/ /rab mdzes dbyangs can lha la mchod par 'bul/ /des ni gsum gyi thog ma yi/

/zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod bstan/ /rkang pa bzhi ka'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dper/ /'od dkar can gyi mdangs ldan zur mig g.yo ba'i gzhan yid 'phrog ma khyod/ /'od dkar 'gyu ba'i rol rtsed dang 'grogs chu skyes dkar po'i steng na rol/ /'od dkar can rgyas dbu la spud cing rin chen rgyan mang spras pa yi/ /'od dkar ldan mas bdag blo'i mun sel ngag gi dbang phyug myur du stsol/ /dang po gnyis kyi thog ma yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dang / /'og ma gnyis kyi thog ma yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dper/ /shel dkar ri bo'i mdangs 'phrog yid 'ong sku/ /shel dkar la sogs rgyan gyi rnam 'gyur 'chang / /'od dkar bsil zer can rgyas steng na 'khod/ /'od dkar ldan mas snying mun sel bar mdzod/ /dang po gsum pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dang / /gnyis pa bzhi pa'i thog ma yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dper/ /chos kun bde chen ro mnyam thugs chud pa'i/ /bsgrub mchog dngos grub de ring bdag la stsol/ /chos kun rmi lam sgyu ma ltar rtogs pa'i/ /bsgrub mchog me tog dad pa'i snyim pas 'bul/ /dang po dang ni bzhi pa yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dang / /de bzhin gnyis pa gsum pa yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dper/ /'khrul ngor snang ba'i dngos 'dzin bag chags ri bo nyi shu mtho ba yang / /gya gyu'i tshul 'dzin smig sgyu'i ri mo mya ngam thang la 'khyams pa 'di/ /gya gyu'i chu klung 'bab par snang yang chu yi dngos pos stong pa bzhin/ /'khrul ngor snang mod yang dag don la grub pa med 'di khyod kyis bstan/ /de rnams kyis ni bar chod pa'i/ /zung ldan bcu gsum bstan zin to/ /da ni chod cing ma chod pa'i/ /dbye ba dag kyang bstan par bya/ /de la sngon gnyis chod ma chod/ /'og gnyis chod cing ma chod dper/

/khrol khrol mu tig gdub skor mdzes pa dang / /khrol khrol phyag zhabs gdu bu'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /sil sil sor gdub sgra skad rab khrol zhing / /sil sil mu tig ga shal mdzes pas spras/ /dang po bzhi pa chod ma chod/ /bar gnyis chod cing ma chod dper/ /gsal gsal blo gros mnga' ba'i spyan yangs ma/ /dung dung lhang lhang tshig gis khyed bos nas/ /dung dung gdung bas gsol ba btab gyur na/ /gsal gsal ma rig mun pa sel bar 'gyur/ /rkang pa bzhi ka'i thog ma la/ /chod cing ma chod gzugs gcig dper/ /mdzes mdzes dga' ma'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /mdzes mdzes rgyan gyi cha rnams ma lus bkra/ /mdzes mdzes thams cad gcig tu bsdus gyur pas/ /mdzes mdzes tshogs pa'i nang na khyed mdzes so/ /de la chod cing ma chod pa'i/ /dbye ba gsum ni bstan zin to /des na thog ma'i zung ldan ni/ /ma chod pa dang chod pa dang / /chod dang ma chod dbye ba ni/ /sum cu gcig yod ngas bstan to/ /dbus dang mtha' yi dbye ba yang / /rgyas par mang dogs 'dir ma bkod/ /de la bya dkar mngon 'dod gang / /'ga' zhig dag ni bstan par bya/ /de yang bzhi ka'i dbus kyi ni/ /chod cing ma chod bshad de dper/ /gang zhig mkhyen pa mkhyen pa bla na med/ /de nyid mkhyen pa mkhyen pa kun gyi mchog /ji snyed mkhyen pa mkhyen pa rgya che bas/ /ma lus mkhyen pa mkhyen pa mchog der 'dud/ /bzhi ka'i dbus kyi chod pa yi/ /dper brjod dag kyang bstan par bya/ /'dam las pad+ma skyes kyang 'dam gyis pad+ma ma gos ltar/ /khyed zhal pad+ma rgyas kyang rdul gyis pad+ma ma gos shing / /ji ltar pad+ma nyi 'od kyis bskyed pad+ma mdzes pa ltar/ /khyed zhabs pad+ma dmar ba'i mdangs ldan pad+ma der phyag 'tshal/ /bzhi ka'i mtha' la gzugs gcig pas/ /chod pa'i zung ldan bshad de dper/ /khyed sku shel gyi lhun po lta bur mdzes/ /gang gsung ka la piṅka lta bur mdzes/ /nyid thugs nyi zla dri bral lta bur mdzes/

/'phrin las kun khyab nam mkha' lta bur mdzes/ /mtha' yi zung ldan gzugs gcig pas/ /chod cing ma chod zung ldan dper/ /khyod kyi 'gro kun byams pas skyong yang bdud sde dpung bcas 'dar bar byed 'di kwa'i kwa'i/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i bzhin pad 'byed kyang bdud mo'i bzhin pad zum par byed 'di kwa'i kwa'i/ /skye 'chi'i tshul las 'das par gyur kyang gdul bya'i don du skye ba'i tshul 'di kwa'i kwa'i/ /khyed kyi 'phrin las dpag nus min yang gdul bya'i khams dang mtshungs par 'jug 'di kwa'i kwa'i/ /bar dang mtha' yi gzugs gcig pa'i/ /chod pa'i zung ldan yin te dper/ /zas gtsang sras bzhin phyag 'tshal gnas gyur khyed la 'gro rnams gus phyag 'tshal/ /shin tu tshogs bsags phyag 'tshal gnas khyed lha brgya'i gtsug gis gus phyag 'tshal/ /sa steng 'di na phyag 'tshal 'os la khyed las gzhan med der phyag 'tshal/ /de phyir kun gyis phyag 'tshal 'dud do slar yang khyed la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bar dang mtha' yi gzugs gcig pas/ /chod cing ma chod zung ldan dper/ /dri med shel dkar ri bo ltar mdzes mdzes lta sdug pa'i khyed sku 'di yang rab mdzes mdzes/ /pi waṃ gling bu'i gdangs ltar rab mdzes mdzes pa'i gsung dbyangs khyed gsung 'di yang rab mdzes mdzes/ /gsal 'grib med pa'i nyi ma ltar mdzes mdzes pa'i byams ldan khyed thugs 'di yang rab mdzes mdzes/ /kun la khyab pa'i nam mkha' ltar mdzes mdzes ldan kun khyab 'phrin las rnam bzhi rab mdzes mdzes/ /thog ma dang ni bar gyi ni/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig chod pa dper/ /rab mdzes dngul dkar pad+ma bzhin du rab mdzes khyed zhal dri ma med/ /rab mdzes nyi 'od 'char ka'i mdangs bzhin rab mdzes mkhur tshos shin tu dmar/ /rab mdzes ut+pal sngon po'i 'khyog bzhin rab mdzes spyan zur phra mo g.yo/ /rab mdzes zhabs zung dmar ba'i sor mo rab mdzes thor cog sngon pos len/

/dang po gsum pa'i thog mtha' ni/ /chod cing ma chod zung ldan dang / /gnyis pa bzhi pa'i thog bar ni/ /chod cing ma chod zung ldan dper/ /mdzes mdzes gcig tu bsdus pa'i dbyangs can ma khyod 'gro kun gtsug gi rgyan du rab mdzes mdzes/ /mdzes mdzes nor bu'i phra tshom bkod pa'i phyag zhabs gdub bus rab mdzes mdzes 'di mig gi dpal/ /mdzes mdzes lha yi na bza' stod g.yogs 'ja' ris bkra ba dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab mdzes mdzes/ /mdzes mdzes zla ba dkar po'i steng na dbyangs can ma khyod rab mdzes mdzes 'di e ma mtshar/ /rkang pa bzhi ka'i thog mtha' yi/ /zung ldan gzugs gcig bar chod dper/ /rab dkar dri med khyed zhal zla ba mchog rab dkar/ /rab dkar dad pa'i ku mud kha 'byed 'dir rab dkar/ /rab dkar dbyangs can khyed zhal 'di yang dpal rab dkar/ /rab dkar khyed la snying nas kho bo snying rab dkar/ /rkang pa bzhi pa'i thog mtha' ni/ /chod cing ma chod zung ldan dper/ /e ma e ma lha mchog khyed dang mjal ba 'di ni skal bar bzang ngo e ma e ma/ /e ma e ma khyed kyi yon tan srid gsum 'dir shong ngo mtshar che yo e ma e ma/ /e ma e ma srid pa las kyi 'khor lo 'di ni ya mtshan che yo e ma e ma/ /e ma e ma srid las grol ba'i lam zab 'di ni khyed kyis bstan no e ma e ma/ /bzhi ka'i thog mtha' bar gsum la/ /chod pa'i zung ldan gzugs gcig dper/ /yid du 'ong ba'i pad dkar dag dang zla dkar gdan la yid du 'ong ba'i bu mo gzugs mdzes rab sgeg 'gying ba'i dbyangs can ma khyod yid du 'ongs/ /yid du 'ongs pa'i rgyan mang sil sil khrol bas brgyan pa'i yid du 'ong khyod skal bzang gdul bya'i snying mun sel ba'i mchog 'di de ring yid du 'ong / /yid du 'ong ba'i zhal ras dkar po mkhur tshos dmar ba yid du 'ong ba'i me tog gis bkra gar du rol pa'i smin ma g.yo 'di'ang yid du 'ong /

/yid du 'ong khyed sked skabs phra zhing nu 'bur mdzes pa yid du 'ong 'di me tog dkar po'i ga sha gyis mdzes sbrang ma lding 'di'ang yid du 'ong / /bzhi ka'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi/ /gzugs gcig chod dang ma chod dper/ /mdzes mdzes 'tshogs pa'i nang na mchog gyur mdzes mdzes rin chen rgyan gyis rab mdzes mdzes/ /mdzes mdzes me tog dkar pos thod bcings mdzes mdzes gser gyi snang ba rab mdzes mdzes/ /mdzes mdzes nu 'bur rgyas pa'i ngos la mdzes mdzes pad+ma'i ga sha rab mdzes mdzes/ /mdzes mdzes dri za'i tshogs dang lhan cig mdzes mdzes rgyud mang bsgyur 'di rab mdzes mdzes/ /des ni dbus dang mtha' sogs kyi/ /zung ldan bcu gnyis bstan zin to/ /rkang pa gnyis pa'i mtha' thog dag /rab tu sbyar ba'i zung ldan 'di/ /brjod pa'i khongs su 'dus mod kyang / /rang dbang dag tu'ang 'dir bshad dper/ /gang zhig shel dkar mchod sdong ltar mdzes pa/ /mdzes pa rmad byung ngo mtshar rab mdzes sku/ /mdzes sku gzhan las ches lhag byed zhabs kyi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mar spyi bos phyag bgyid do/ /kun tu zung ldan bshad par bya/ /rkang pa bzlas dang tshig bcad bzlas/ /zung ldan chen mo rnams dang gsum/ /rkang pa bzlas la phyed bzlas dang / /rkang rer bzlas pa gnyis su yod/ /phyed bzlas la yang rnam gsum ste/ /de la dang po gsum par bzlas/ /gnyis pa bzhi par bzlas te dper/ /rab gsal dri med rdul gyis ma gos 'od ris ring du 'phro ba can/ /'gro ba'i kun dga' bskyed pa'i mchog tu de ring mig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ /rab gsal dri med rdul gyis ma gos 'od ris ring du 'phro ba can/ /'gro ba'i kun dga' bskyed pa'i mchog tu de ring mig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ /ces 'di'i tshig rkang dang po gnyis/ /zla ba la sbyar 'og ma gnyis/ /dbyangs can mchog la sbyar bar bya/ /dang po gnyis par bzlas pa dang / /gsum pa bzhi par bzlas pa dper/

/ma la ya yi ri ngos las 'ongs ga pur bsil ba'i dpal ldan pa/ /ma la ya yi ri ngos las 'ongs ga pur bsil ba'i dpal ldan pa/ /gang gi lus la reg pas bde zhing snying la sim pa ster bar byed/ /ma la ya yi chu rgyun dang / /ma la ya yi rlung gis ni/ /dbyangs can nyid dang bu mo yis/ /snying la sim pa ster ba ston/ /dang po bzhi par bzlas pa dang / /gnyis pa gsum par bzlas pa dper/ /dal gyis 'gro ba'i bu mo yid 'ong ma/ /me tog dkar po'i thod bcings phreng bas mdzes/ /me tog dkar po'i thod bcings phreng bas mdzes/ /dal gyis 'gro ba'i bu mo yid 'ong ma/ /dbyangs can ma dang nor rgyun ma/ /me tog phreng bas mdzes pa ston/ /de rnams kyis ni phyed bzlas pa'i/ /dbye ba gsum ni bstan zin to/ /rkang pa re re bzlas pa yang / /bcu ru yod pa'i nang nas ni/ /dang po gnyis par bzlas pa dper /gang zla ba/ gi 'od zer lhung ba'i cha shas kyis/ /gang dbyangs can/ gi 'od zer lhung ba'i cha shas kyis/ /rab mdzes pad+mo'i tshal ni zum byed cing / /bdud mo'i bzhin pad dag kyang zum par byed/ /zla ba'i 'od kyis pad+mo dang / /dbyangs can 'od kyis bdud mo yi/ /bzhin pad zum par byed par ston/ /dang po gsum par bzlas pa dper/ /khyed zhal zla ba dri med dkar po 'di/ /mthong bas 'gro kun snying la dga' bskyed kyang / /khyod zhal zla ba dri med dkar po 'di/ /mthong bas 'dod pa'i snying la mya ngan sbyin/ /dang po bzhi par bzlas pa dper/ /khyed kyi thugs rje'i phyag gis drang du gsol/ /skal dman gdul byar gyur pa'i skye bo dang / /nya yi tog can 'khor bar mi btang par/ /khyed kyi thugs rje'i phyag gi drang du gsol/ /gnyis pa gsum par bzlas pa dper/ /khyed kyi gsung dbyangs thos pa de phan chad/ /'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /'on kyang sngags kyi nus pa 'dis kyang ngo /

/dbyangs can gsung dang sngags nus kyis/ /'chi med go 'phang thob par byas/ /gnyis pa bzhi par bzlas pa dper/ /bdag sogs 'khor bar 'khyams rnams sngon chad du'ang / /dbyangs can khyed kyi thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /da dung 'khor ba ji srid ma stong bar/ /dbyangs can khyed kyi thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /gsum pa bzhi par bzlas pa dper/ /gang gi zhabs zung bkra shis 'khor lo'i ri mos mtshan/ /bsod nams dpal 'byor 'od brgya pa 'di gang dang gang / /ral pa'i spyi gtsug cod pan rgyan du gus pas len/ /ral pa'i spyi gtsug con pan rgyan du gus pas len/ /dbyangs can zhabs zung 'khor lo ni/ /lha dang mi gnyis gang gang gi /ral ba'i cod pan dag tu bstan/ /rkang pa dang po gnyis pa dang / /gsum par bzlas pa ston te dper/ /dri med rab gsal dkar po 'od phreng can/ /dri med rab gsal dkar po 'od phreng can/ /dri med rab gsal dkar po 'od phreng can/ /rim bzhin pad zla'i steng na dbyangs can rol/ /rkang pa dang po gsum pa dang / /bzhi par bzlas pa bshad de dper/ /rnam dkar dri med rab gsal yid 'phrog mig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ /dbyangs can nyid yin gzhan yang pad dkar zla gnyis rim pa bzhin/ /rnam dkar dri med rab gsal yid 'phrog mig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ /rnam dkar dri med rab gsal yid 'phrog mig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ /rkang pa gnyis pa gsum pa dang / /bzhi par bzlas pa ston te dper/ /'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum du ni/ /dbyangs can spyan zur rol pas bdag la gzigs/ /dbyangs can spyan zur rol pas bdag la gzigs/ /dbyangs can spyan zur rol pas bdag la gzigs/ /rkang pa dang po gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa bzhi par bzlos te dper/ /na tsha med so so skye bo/ rnams kha bas tsha nam mkha'i/ ba tshad pa/ 'joms su dogs zhes dbyangs can mdzes ma ci phyir smra/ /na tsha med pa'i skye bo/

rnams kha sman ro/ bas tsha nad/ ba 'joms su dogs zhes dbyangs can mdzes ma ci phyir smra/ /na tsha zhing / med pa'i skye bo/ rnams kha bas nam mkha'i/ tsha tshad pa/ ba 'joms su dogs zhes dbyangs can mdzes ma ci phyir smra/ /na zhing / tsha med pa'i skye bo/ rnams kha bas sman ro/ tsha nad/ ba 'joms su dogs zhes dbyangs can mdzes ma ci phyir smra /de rnams kyis ni rkang pa ni/ /lan gcig bzlas dang lan gnyis bzlas/ /lan gsum lan bzhi bzlas pa yi/ /dbye ba bcu gsum bstan zin to/ /tshigs bcad lan gnyis bzlas pa las/ /tha dad don ni ston pa gang / /tshigs bcad bzlas pa yin te dper/ /tsha tshad pa/ bas gdung pas skye bo ngal ngal po/ /kha ba nam mkha'i/ 'di yis khyed lus brtas par byed/ /kha ba'i chu 'dis skoms pa'i gdung ba dang / /tsha ba'i nad sel dbyangs can khyed kyi gsungs/ /tsha nad/ bas gdung pa'i skye bo ngal ngal po/ /kha sman ro/ ba 'di yis khyed lus brtas par byed/ /kha sman ro/ /ba'i chu 'dis skoms pas gdung pa dang / /tsha ba'i nad sel dbyangs can khyed kyi gsung / /tshig bcad snga ma phyi mar bzlos/ /tshig gcig don gnyis tha dad ston/ /tshigs bcad bzlos pa zhes bya'o/ /rkang pa bzhi ka gzugs gcig kyang / /tha dad don ni ston pa gang / /zung ldan chen por brjod pa yin/ /rkang bzhi bzlas dang khyad yod de/ /re re'ang phyed phyed 'di la 'khor/ /'di yi dper brjod legs sbyar la/ /gsal gyi bod kyi sdeb sbyor la/ /mkhas pa dga' ba bskyed mi nus/ /'on kyang cung zad dper mtshon na/ /kwa ye kwa ye rmad sku'i/ byung dpal 'di khyed la mnga'o/ /kwa ye kwa ye rmad gsung gi byung dpal 'di khyed la mnga'o/ /kwa ye kwa ye rmad thugs kyi/ byung dpal 'di khyed la mnga' 'o/ /kwa ye kwa ye rmad 'phrin las kyi/

byung dpal 'di khyed la mnga'o/ /kwa ye kwa ye rmad mkhyen pa'i/ byung dpal 'di khyed la mnga'o/ /kwa ye kwa ye rmad brtse ba'i/ byung dpal 'di khyed la mnga'o/ /kwa ye kwa ye rmad nus pa'i/ byung dpal 'di khyed la mnga'o/ /kwa ye kwa ye rmad mtshan dpe'i/ byung dpal 'di khyed la mnga'o/ /zhes pa dbyangs can lha mo yi/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'phrin las dang / /mkhyen brtse nus pa mtshan dpe sogs/ /rmad byung dpal 'di mnga' bar bstan/ /'dres pa'i zung ldan bstan par bya/ /de la chod cing ma chod dang / /mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan dang / /chod pa'i zung ldan rnams yod dper/ /khrol khrol 'khrol ba'i gdu bu dang ni khrol khrol rgyan gyis rab mdzes pa/ /mdzes pa kun bsdus dpal mo mchog khyed dpal mo bzang ldan de rab mchog /rab mchog bu mo mdzes ldan ma de mdzes ldan gtsug na rab mtho ba/ /mtho ba rnams kyis mchog tu bkur ba'i mchog tu mdzes khyod de ring mtho/ /zlog pa'i zung ldan bshad par bya/ /rkang gcig phyed dang rang sa gang / /lugs las zlos nas bzlas pa ni/ /zung ldan lugs zlog dag tu 'dod/ /de la dang po gnyis pa zlos/ /gsum pa bzhi pa zlog pas na/ /rkang pa zlog pa zhes bya ste/ /'dres pa'i zung ldan rgyan yod dper/ /mdzes mdzes dbyangs can dpal mo dpal rab mchog /mchog rab dpal mo dpal can dbyangs mdzes mdzes/ /dge legs dpal mo dpal ldan dbyangs can mchog /mchog can dbyangs ldan dpal mo dpal legs dge /rkang pa dang po gnyis dang ni/ /phyi ma gnyis ni phyed zlog sbyar/ /zung ldan chod dang ma chod yod/ /de ni phyed zlog yin te dper/ /legs legs kun bsdus dbyangs can snyan rab kun legs legs/ /legs legs dpal ldan dpal mo dpal khyed dpal legs legs/ /legs legs dpal khyed dpal mo dpal ldan dpal legs legs/ /legs legs rab snyan dbyangs can dbyangs bsdus kun legs legs/

/'dres pa'i zung ldan rab sbyar ba'i/ /tshig bcad gong ma nyid dang ni/ /'og ma dag ni lugs zlog sbyar/ /tshig bcad ldog pa yin te dper/ /lha yi lha mo lha mchog dpal khyed mkhas/ /'tsher 'tsher rab mdzes rgyan gyis brgyan 'dis mdzes/ /khrol khrol rab snyan rgyud mang bsgyur la mdzes/ /'dzum 'dzum rab bzhad rab mdzes mdzes mchog mdzes/ /mdzes mchog mdzes mdzes rab bzhad rab 'dzum 'dzum/ /mdzes la rgyud mang rgyud snyan rab khrol khrol/ /mdzes 'dis rgyan gyis brgyan mdzes rab 'tsher 'tsher/ /mkhas khyed dpal mchog lha mo lha yi lha/ /lugs ldog rgyan gsum bstan zin to/ /bya dka'i khyad par gzhan brjod pa/ /glang po'i 'gros dang phyed 'khor dang / /kun 'khor zhes bya rnam gsum yod/ /de la dkyus kyi yi ge dang / /steng 'og 'khyog 'gros gzugs gcig nyid/ /de ni bya dka'i de nyid rig /glang po'i 'gros zhes bya ste dper/ /khyed kyis bdag la thos pa'i me tog dang / /bsgrub pa'i me tog rab tu stsol bar mdzod/ /nged kyis khyed la dad pa'i me tog dang / /gus pa'i me tog rab tu 'bul bar bgyi/ /zhes pa phreng 'phred gnyis bkod nas/ /steng ma 'og tu bsnol ba dang / /steng ma cig gi 'og ma ni/ /steng du bsnol ba 'og dang gcig /de ni glang po'i 'gros zhes bya/ /gal te tshig bcad gcig 'khor na/ /phyed du 'khor ba'i bya dkar brjod/ /re mig sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /'khor lo bkod la lta bar bya/ /de yang phyed du bgos pa yis/ /dang po dang po dag tu 'khor/ /de bzhin phyi ma phyi mar 'khor/ /de yang dang po'i dang por 'khor/ /de bzhin gnyis pa gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa dang ni gsum pa dang / /bzhi pa bzhi pa dag tu 'khor/ /de bzhin phyi ma dag la yang / /lugs ldog tshul du rim bzhin 'khor/ /'khor ba'i gzugs rnams gcig tu 'byung / /gong 'og gnyis po tha dad do/ /de ni phyed du 'khor ba'o/

/gnyis ka gzugs cig kun tu 'khor/ /kun tu 'khor ba'i bya dkar brjod/ /de la'ang re mig sum cu gnyis/ /'khor lo bkod la lta bar byed/ /de yang phyed du bgos nas ni/ /dang po dang ni phyi ma gnyis/ /lugs 'byung lugs ldog tshul du ni/ /dang po dang po dag tu 'khor/ /de bzhin gnyis pa sogs la'ang 'gre /gong 'og gnyis po gzugs gcig 'khor/ /de ni kun tu 'khor ba'o/ /dbyangs dang gnas dang gsal byed rnams/ /gcig gnyis gsum bzhi tshun chod kyi/ /nges pa gang 'di bya dka' la/ /gzhan ni bya sla dag tu 'dod/ /de la a yig gcig pu ru/ /nges pa'i dbyangs nges bstan de dper/ /dbyangs can dga' ma gzhan las khyad 'phags na/ /spang bya bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs nas/ /mtha' yas gzhal bya 'jal la spyan yangs ma/ /gang na gnas kyang bdag cag dang pas dad/ /i yi yi ge gcig pu ru/ /nges pa'i dbyangs nges bstan de dper/ /bzhin gyi mig gi mthing ris ni/ /yid kyi bris kyi pir gyi min/ /ting 'dzin de nyid gzigs 'di yi/ /nyid kyi sgrib gnyis ri 'di bshig /u yi yi ge gcig pu ru/ /nges pa'i dbyangs nges bstan te dper/ /lhun grub phul byung dus kun tu/ /thugs su chud gyur sku gsum 'grub/ /bdud dpung nus mthu kun tu btul/ /dung dung gdung gyur myur du 'dud/ /e yi yi ge gcig pu ru/ /nges pa'i dbyangs nges bstan te dper/ /mkhyen brtse dbyer med brtse chen khyed/ /dge legs bde chen dpe med mnyes/ /theg chen skye med ye shes de/ /ster byed de tshe nges shes skye/ /o yi yi ge gcig pu ru/ /nges pa'i dbyangs nges bstan te dper/ /mchog tshogs gtso bo mgon po khyod/ /chos 'khor 'khor lo gtso bo bskor/ /nyon mongs khong khro gtso bor bcom/ /dgos 'dod stsol khyod mgo bos mchod/ /i yig u yig gnyis su ni/ /nges pa'i dbyangs nges bstan te dper/

/skye med bde chen dbyer med gnyis/ /myur du bdud dpung kun tu btul/ /ye shes me chen me lce des/ /dug gsum myur du rdul du thul/ /i dang u dang e gsum dang / /nges pa'i dbyangs nges bstan te dper/ /sil sil bsil zhing di ring 'dir/ /sdug kun myur du sun dbyung gyur/ /mdzes mdzes legs legs dpe med de/ /rig rig mig gis de ring gzigs/ /e dang u dang o dang ni/ /i yig bzhi yi dbyangs nges dper/ /mkhyen brtse dpe med ye shes skye/ /su 'dug ku su lu ru 'dug /chos 'khor skor mdzod nyon mongs 'joms/ /nyid kyis ting 'dzin 'di ni bgyi/ /dbyangs nges bzhi ni bstan zin la/ /gzhan yang mang du spros pas chog /'dir ni mang dogs ma bris so/ /da ni gnas nges bstan par bya/ /so yi gnas ni gcig pu las/ /nges pa'i gnas nges bstan te dper/ /la la da ni nad sos nas/ /la la le los bstod la dad/ /la la don ldan las la der/ /la la le los las las thar/ /so dang mchu yi gnas gnyis las/ /byung ba'i gnas nges bstan te dper/ /dpal ldan dpal mo don ldan ma/ /la las dpal mo dpal thob ste/ /la la dad pas nus pa thob/ /nad med dpal ni don du ldan/ /mgrin pa so dang mchu gsum las/ /byung ba'i gnas nges bstan te dper/ /dpal ldan dpal mo dge ma de/ /bde stong stong gsal ngang la gnas/ /bdag ni dang bas dad pa lags/ /deng nas bdag la dge legs stsol/ /mgrin pa rkan dang so dang ni/ /mchu las byung ba'i gnas nges dper/ /kwa yi dbyangs can mdzes ldan ma/ /khyed la snying nas dad lags kyi/ /bdag gi snying gi mun pa ni/ /sel la blo mchog sbyin du gsol/ /des ni gnas nges bzhi bstan zin/ /rgyas par mang du spros pas chog /'dir ni mang dogs ma bris so/ /gsal byed nges pa bstan par bya/ /de yang ra yig gcig pu yi/ /gsal byed gcig tu nges pa dper/ /ri ri dwags/

ru ru ru re re sdod la/ ru/ /ru ru re re ra re pa'i rigs/ re/ /ri ru ra sdod la/ re re re ru/ sdod la/ /ra re ru ru sdod pa'i rang bzhin/ re re ri/ /da yig dang ni ra yig gi /gsal byed gnyis su nges pa dper/ /dad do ru ru re re ru/ /dad do dad do da dad do/ /ded do ru ru re re ru/ /ded do ded do da ded do/ /ra dang la dang da gsum gyis/ /gsal byed gsum du nges pa dper/ /ded spyang bus/ do ra re re re ru/ /ded do ded do ri la ded/ /la spyang bu/ la ra ro re la rol/ /la la re ro re la rol/ /ra la sha da bzhir nges pa'i/ /gsal byed bzhi ru nges pa dper/ /ded rngon pas ri dwags rnams/ do ri la re re ru/ /ded do ded do lo rer ded/ /la ri dwags/ la shi la la la shor/ /la la glo/ lur lur ded do lo/ /des na gsal byed gcig sogs su/ /nges pa bzhi ni bstan zin la/ /rgyas par mang dogs 'dir ma bkod/ /gzhan du rgya cher spros la rtsoms/ /'dir brjod sgra rgyan rnam grangs ni/ /thog ma'i zung ldan sum cu gcig /dbus mtha'i zung ldan bcu gnyis dang / /mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan gcig /rkang bzlas bcu bzhi tshig bcad bzlas/ /zung ldan chen mo 'dres pa yi/ /zung ldan re re rnams su yod/ /ldog pa'i rgyan gsum bya dka' gsum/ /dbyangs nges rgyan dang gnas nges bzhi/ /gsal byed nges pa bzhi yod pas/ /kun dril glang po'i 'gros dang / phyed 'khor/ kun 'khor te bya dka' gsum po re mig na bkod pas gsum po mi the ba'i/ bdun cu dgu ru yod/ /rgyas par 'dod na mang du spros/ /gang zhig mtha' thog sbyar ba'i rjes khrid/ 'di dang gzhan du bde ba'i lam/ /lam mchog bsgrub la snyan dngags gtso bor bstan/ /bstan bcos rnams kyi nang na 'di mchog rigs/ /rigs tshul phra mo'i gnas tshul 'di na yod/

/skye rjes khrid/ ba skye bar goms pa'i chos tshul la/ /yang dang yang du 'dres pa'i nges shes thob/ /mkhas pa mkhas pa'i tshogs la rab nyan nas/ /slob bu slob ma'i tshogs la da lta sbyin/ /chos kun kun bar gyi zung ldan chod la ma chod pa dang mtha'i rjes khrid/ shes bdud dpung dpung tshogs thub/ /thub dbang dbang gi shes rgyun rgyun du dal/ /dal 'byor 'byor tshe sgra tshad tshad med bslab/ /bslab shes shes kyang nga rgyal rgyal mtshan bsnyal/ /bsnyal las las ni bzo rig rig byed shes/ /shes rab rab ldan gso rig rig byed sbyangs/ /sbyangs 'bras 'bras bu nang rig rig byed mkhas/ /mkhas mchog mchog tu legs grub grub pa'i dus/ /dge legs dpe med bde chen mnyes te mtsheng / /mdun du gzhung lugs phul byung zhu ru byung / /dpal ldan sa las rab rgyal ā nan+da/ kun dga'/ /mchod do dkon mchog mchod do brtson no lo/ /zhes 'di nas sh+lau ka gsum rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan/ gang smra bo gang de phyogs kun las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i sa skya pa nga yin/ /de skad smra la rgol ba su yang med/ /de tshe kun gyi rna bar kho bo snyan/ /sngon chad gangs ri'i khrod kyi mkhas pa rnams/ /snyan dngags chos tshul 'di la 'dris zhen pas/ /bltas pa tsam gyis slob dpon du 'gyur ba'i/ /yig 'jog tshang la ma nor bkod pa med/ /de phyir kho bos brtse bas kun bslangs nas/ /kun la phan par 'gyur ba'i smon lam btab/ /ma 'ongs kun gyis shes 'gyur slob dpon du/ /ser sna spangs te kho bos gsal bar bkod/ /de las mtha' thog sbyar ba'i rjes khrid/ byung ba'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /kun mkhyen thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang / /khang bzang mchog tu bde chen rnam rol sku/ /sku gnyis zung 'jug da lta thob par shog /ces sgra rgyan gyi bstan bcos mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog blo gsal mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/

sgra dang snyan dngags dang ming gi mngon brjod dang zlos gar la sogs te tha snyad kyi gtsug lag rnams la mkhyen rab kyi snang ba phyogs med du rgyas shing / gzhan yang lung sde snod man ngag dang bcas pa rnams la mtshungs pa med pa'i mkhas pa chen po dpal snar thang gi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po saṃ gha shrīs mdzad pa'i sgra rgyan gsal ba'i me long mkhas pa dga' byed 'od zer rgyas pa nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin nyung gsal go bde'i ngag gis bkod pa 'di ni/ srid pa gsum gyi bla ma dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang / yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin bslu med dam pa rnams kyi zhabs sen dbang gi rgyal po spyi bo'i rgyan du bkod pa'i shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lhag bsam dag pas kun nas bslangs te/ deng sang dus ngan snyigs ma mthar thug pa'i skabs 'dir skye bo rnams gal chung chos kyi bya ba la babs nas mkhas pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos 'di lta bu la ji snyam du yang mi sems par bzhi mdo'i rtswa bzhin 'dor ba blos ma bzod de/ da dung blo gsal dpyod ldan shes 'dod can re re tsam la phan par gyur na snyam nas/ shing pho khyi'i lo zla ba dang po'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa gsung rab mang po'i mgrin pa can mdo sngags rab 'byams smra ba bsam gtan rgya mtshos bgyis so/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin cing don kun 'grub pa dang /
